What is Meth?

blocks.html: Meth is a synthetic drug that is made using a variety of different chemicals.  Meth is a highly addictive drug that can lead to physical and psychological dependence. Meth can be smoked, snorted, and used intravenously.
blocks.text: Meth is a synthetic drug that is made using a variety of different chemicals. Meth is a highly addictive drug that can lead to physical and psychological dependence. Meth can be smoked, snorted, and used intravenously.

blocks.html: Meth is often cooked outside of the United States and smuggled in. This is not to say that there are no meth labs in the US- because there are. There is a significant danger associated with cooking meth because of the different chemicals that are being used. The fumes produced while making meth can be dangerous, and explosions can occur as well.
